The following observations were collected during experimentation on a clear sample solution created by dissolving two different inorganic salts in distilled water:
- Addition of AgNO3 to the sample solution results in a pale yellow precipitate.
- This pale yellow precipitate partially (but not fully) dissolves in aqueous ammonia, and precipitates again up acidification.
- Addition of Hg(NO3)2 to the sample solution results in a yellow-orange precipitate.
 - Addition of KOH to the sample solution results in a white precipitate that does not dissolve in excess KOH.
- No flame color is observed from the sample.

Assuming that all of the above statements are true, which of the following options is correct?
